description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, untapping Karametra's Acolyte
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least seven {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
